  - heading "Describe the product. Get the interface." [level=1]
  - paragraph: Tessellate turns product intent into cohesive interface systems using an open library of components, patterns, motion and design intelligence.
  - text: "Preset Exemplars:"
  - group "Preset briefs":
    - button "AI research terminal"
    - button "luxury travel marketplace"

  - text: Deterministic Core Active
  - textbox "Product description and requirements":
    - /placeholder: Describe what this product does, its users, complexity, and visual atmosphere…
    - text: A professional but playful employee experience platform for a 500-person technology company. Warm onboarding journeys, team discovery, peer recognition, and trusted workplace policies.
  - group: Feel, ambition and structure professional but playful · 60 ambition · 50 structure
  - button "Compose":
    - text: Compose
    - img
  - paragraph: Three directions, one product
  - heading "Choose a direction. Or blend them." [level=2]
  - paragraph: Generate an employee experience example with the real catalogue and composer. Compare its sidebar, editorial and rail workspace structures, then edit the exact project in Workbench.
  - button "Generate example directions"
  - link "Compose your own brief":
    - /url: /compose
  - text: The Composition Paradigm
  - heading "Not a component library. A composition system." [level=2]
  - paragraph: A resource catalogue gives you reusable building blocks. Tessellate adds a product brief, shared design settings, and a manifest that connects screens, resources, and project intent.
  - img
  - heading "Starting from a Resource Catalogue" [level=3]
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Choose resources:"
      - text: The product team decides which components belong on each screen.
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Carry design decisions:"
      - text: Shared tokens and interaction patterns need to stay aligned across resources.
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Connect the screens:"
      - text: The team defines navigation, content, and how interface parts work together.
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Review generated code:"
